claims: SpaceX is not directly involved in the flight hardware or launch of the Artemis II mission
Artemis II mission uses NASA’s own Space Launch System (SLS) rocket
Artemis II mission uses Orion capsule
SpaceX has been awarded contracts to develop the Starship Human Landing System (HLS) for future missions, specifically Artemis III
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby (no landing)
Artemis II uses legacy SLS/Orion systems to test deep-space habitation and navigation
SpaceX is contracted to provide the Starship HLS to land astronauts on the Moon starting with the Artemis III mission
